task_title: Sync-lane drift repairs: CF-053 commit binding, completion-event gap audit, BOARD.md census
task_criteria:
Sync-lane drift repairs, all verifiable from the committed tree at the closeout tip:
(1) `.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` parses line by line: `jq -c . <board>` exits 0 and `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints `PASS 114/114 rows parse` (count may rise if another lane folds rows; the parse line must match the measured row count).
(2) CF-053 carries a non-null `commit_hash` equal to the full SHA 80fca8bf3a7be28899cc13a1041a7869693d677e, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 80fca8bf3a7be28899cc13a1041a7869693d677e origin/main` exits 0.
(3) The two completion-event gaps (CF-034, CF-041: status complete with no `task_completed` event) are recorded as ONE appended `audit` event naming both ids, their completion dates and the fact that no transition was minted; no completion event is fabricated for either id.
(4) `docs/BOARD.md`'s "Current measured state" block quotes the row/event census, validator result and selftest verdict measured at the committed tip, not the older 104-row/148-event/21d3265 snapshot.
(5) `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints `RESULT: OK` and `bash tests/selftest.sh` exits 0 with `SELFTEST: PASS` on the committed tree, and the commit is pushed so `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...HEAD` is `0 0`.
